text_blocks.snippet: Diphtheria treatment primarily involves diphtheria antitoxin and antibiotics. Antitoxin neutralizes the toxin produced by the bacteria, while antibiotics eliminate the bacteria itself. Treatment is most effective when started promptly after a clinical diagnosis.

list.title: Diphtheria Antitoxin (DAT):
list.snippet: This is the most crucial treatment for respiratory diphtheria. It neutralizes the toxin before it can damage the body. It's administered intravenously or intramuscularly.

list.title: Antibiotics:
list.snippet: Antibiotics like penicillin or erythromycin are used to kill the bacteria and prevent further spread. They also help reduce the period of contagiousness.
